text:
# Pre-market brief, Fri Oct 23, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:25 AM ET)

1. **Telcos hit again, towers bid.** Bloomberg: SpaceX in talks to lease ~80,000 US cell sites for a fourth national carrier. T -4.2%, TMUS -4.3%, VZ -3.6%; CCI +7.6% (named in talks), AMT +5.5% pre. Telco group stays in avoid. ([CNBC 7:41 AM](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/23/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-att-spacex-moderna-deckers-bloom-energy-and-more.html), [Investing 7:47 AM](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-crown-castle-jumps-75-on-spacex-talks-autoliv-slides-4969100))
2. **Futures soft after Nasdaq's worst day since June:** Dow -0.6%, S&P -0.2%, NDX -0.1% at 7:15 AM. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-crown-castle-jumps-75-on-spacex-talks-autoliv-slides-4969100), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-23-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-tesla-meta-093000521.html))
3. **Oil up, yields steady, BTC flat.** Brent ~$114 (highest since early May), WTI ~$100.6 on Houthi strikes on Saudi sites and post-midterm Iran-strike reports. 10-yr ~4.97% after its biggest drop in over a year. BTC ~$81.7k. Gold ~$4,000. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/23/bonds-yields-us-treasurys.html), [Bloomberg/swissinfo](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/tech-rout-pauses-with-oil-rise-capping-relief%3A-markets-wrap/92260391))
4. **Earnings movers:** SLB beat (rev $9.45B, adj EPS $0.64; data-center +76%; $3.4B Kelvion deal) ([X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2113591098992164866)). AXP -2.5% despite FY guide raise. ALV -6.3% on miss. DECK -6.7% (revenue miss, FY sales guide cut). WDC -3.4 to -4.5% and BE -2.5% despite beats (capex/FCF worries). MRNA -5.7% after -25% Thu. RNG +15.8%. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/23/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-att-spacex-moderna-deckers-bloom-energy-and-more.html), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-crown-castle-jumps-75-on-spacex-talks-autoliv-slides-4969100), [MarketChameleon](https://marketchameleon.com/Reports/PremarketTrading))
5. **Calendar:** Flash PMIs 9:45, UMich 10:00 today. Next week: V 10/27, AMT 10/27, MSFT/GOOGL 10/28, FOMC 10/28, AMZN 10/29, XOM 10/30 BMO (corrected from TBD) ([XOM IR](https://investor.exxonmobil.com/company-information/press-releases/detail/1212/exxonmobil-to-release-third-quarter-2026-financial-results)).

**Swing ideas (long-only)**
- **CCI**: named in SpaceX tower talks; towers were the right read-through on the last SpaceX/telco shock (10/9). Conf: med. Risk: talks unconfirmed, +7.6% gap can fade.
- **SLB**: beat with oilfield momentum plus data-center growth while Brent >$110. Conf: low. Risk: oil premium reverses on Iran de-escalation.

Holds unchanged (LMT, PG, SPOT, etc., no re-adds). New avoids: DECK, ALV, MRNA, WDC.
